text:
alex: noticed intermittent keystore-agent OOMs on onprem-eu-2 and audit-forwarder failing to ship lines to retention :warning:
infra-bot: deploy-monitor: keystore-agent crashed x3 in 12m on nodes eu-2a, eu-2b. restarting pods.
priya: timeline: 03/22 09:03 node reboot -> keystore-agent v1.7.1 restarted -> by 09:08 lots of `audit: dropped` in local log.
dan: any signal in the container logs? stack trace?
laura: logs show `OpenSSL: EVP_CipherInit_ex: assertion failed` followed by segfaults. looks like libcrypto mismatch after kernel update.
priya: CVE-2026-XXXX was patched in distro but our custom libcrypto build for HSM shim is v1.1.0-alpha. that combination can trigger memory corruption in multithreaded cipher contexts.
alex: if keystore-agent segfaults it may not flush audit records before restart. that explains missing audit lines. we need to make a forensic snapshot before we rotate keys.
secbot: recommended action: isolate affected nodes from external network, collect /var/log/audit.log, and snapshot container fs. tagging as high-priority incident.
dan: agree. propose steps: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) snapshot disk + dmesg 3) extract vault-unseal audit and keystore local audit 4) patch HSM shim to linked stable openssl 1.1.1 5) rotate any keys used in last 24h if unflushed.
laura: we also have netpols that block egress for audit-forwarder, and a policy change last week allowed logs to queue locally but not ship. I see queued files at `/var/lib/audit/queue/*.log`.
mike: so two failure modes: agent crash (no flush) + netpol prevents ship -> retention missing. are there partial uploads to s3-retention?
priya: checked S3 bucket prefixes: tenant/42/keystore/2026/03/22 has gaps between 09:05-09:12. correlates with crashes.
alex: for immediate containment: cordon nodes eu-2a/eu-2b, run `kubectl -n keystore exec -it keystore-agent-*-xx -- tar czf /tmp/fs-snap.tgz /var/lib/audit /var/log/keystore /proc/self/maps` then copy off to secure-bucket.
laura: net team, can you temporarily open egress to retention endpoint from audit-forwarder pods so queued logs can flush? we need confirmation of no leak to public internet.
laura: proposed netpol change (canary):
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-audit-ship-canary
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: audit-forwarder
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 10.240.50.0/24
          ports:
            - protocol: TCP
              port: 443
```
laura: apply to a single node via nodeSelector and monitor.
dan: while netpol is addressed, we must handle cryptographic integrity: if some keys were used and we cannot prove no leakage because audit gap exists -> rotate those KMS keys and create new ones with rewrap.
priya: list of keys touched between 08:50-09:20: `key-alpha, key-bravo, key-gamma` per vault audit master. we should rotate them and issue rewrap requests to consumers.
secbot: checklist reminder: update incident channel, escalate to compliance for potential data access window, and freeze breakglass tokens until confirm.
alex: I'm running `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit.log` on the control plane to get immediate redundancy. also increasing local audit retention to 14d temporarily.
mike: how disruptive will rewrapping be to the product? need owners to coordinate maintenance windows.
dan: rewrap operation: `vault write transit/rewrap key=key-alpha ciphertext=<old>` -- we should script consumer rollout. target maintenance in 30m windows per region.
priya: to avoid repeated crashes, I have a short-term workaround: set ENV `OPENSSL_THREAD_SAFE=0` in keystore-agent which avoids multithreaded EVP paths. will redeploy patched image with stable OpenSSL tomorrow.
laura: note: can't rely on env workaround long-term; must patch shim. schedule patch release and onboard QA to hit HSM calls.
secbot: forensic data path created: secure-bucket/incidents/1741000001/{node-snap,container-logs,audit-backups}. access restricted.
laura: post-incident action items: 1) pin openssl version in build matrix 2) add preflight pthread/openssl tests for HSM shim 3) add telemetry that alerts when audit-forwarder queue > 100MB 4) amend RBAC so that audit-forwarder can write to retention from a restricted egress CIDR.
alex: I'll write the incident summary and assign remediation. For now, cordon + snapshot + open canary egress + rotate keys key-alpha/bravo/gamma. Everyone ack?
mike: ack. starting rota for rewrap scripts.
priya: I'm uploading snapshots now: secure-bucket/incidents/1741000001/fsnap.tar.gz
dan: starting key rotation job in background, will post logs to the incident folder.
alax: thanks team. will keep thread updated.
